description.en: Records how the battle referee's vocabulary (power enums, buffs, debuffs, status effects) is converted into numbers. Each action becomes one record: the battle_action, every damage/defense calculation that ran inside it with its caller chain, and a full attribute diff of every combatant (so we learn where AttributeEffect and TextStatusEffect actually land without guessing attribute names). The two numeric functions are also called actively on a grid of representative values at injection time, to map the attack-vs-defense curve without playing dozens of battles. Reading only
description.ja: 審判 LLM の語彙（power の列挙・バフ・デバフ・状態異常）が数へ変換されるところを録る。1手を1件にして、battle_action と、その手の中で走ったダメージ・防御の計算（呼び出し元の連鎖つき）と、戦闘に居る全員の属性の差分を残す（バフがどの属性へ書かれるかを、属性名を推測せずに見つけるため）。数値だけを取る2関数は注入時に代表値の格子でも呼び、攻撃対防御の曲線を何十戦も遊ばずに写す。読み取りだけでゲームは変えない

note.ja: 1手（継続効果・手の外の計算も1件と数える）ごとに1行。溜まったら止まる。0 にすると録らない
note.en: One line per action (status turns and out-of-action calculations also count). Recording stops at this many. 0 = do not record

label.ja: 式のグリッドを呼ぶ回数
label.en: Grid repeats for the damage formulas

note.ja: 注入時にダメージ式2つを代表値の格子で直接呼ぶ。同じ点をこの回数ずつ呼んで乱数の幅を見る。0 にするとグリッドごとやらない
note.en: At injection the two damage formulas are called on a grid of representative values, each point this many times to expose randomness. 0 = skip the grid entirely
